incorrect_output.name: Incorrect Output
incorrect_output.description: For cases in which we have a definitive ground truth, e.g., mathematical problems.

poor_performance.name: Poor Performance
poor_performance.description: The model does not satisfy metrics of interest. This is application dependent.

repetitive_output.name: Repetitive Output
repetitive_output.description: The model starts repeating the output tokens at any point during generation.

instruction_negligence.name: Instruction Negligence
instruction_negligence.description: An instruction (or a series thereof) is not followed properly, or ignored altogether. In cases where a series of instructions is provided, order is ignored too.

exaggerated_safety.name: Exaggerated Safety
exaggerated_safety.description: Safe prompts are refused because, for instance, the follow the same structure as unsafe ones or mention sensitive topics.

harmful_output.name: Harmful Output
harmful_output.description: The outputs are toxic, reflect societal biases,  stereotypes, or promote unethical practices. This can be application dependent.

vague_output.name: Vague Output
vague_output.description: The output does not provide an answer to the query, is phrased ambiguously, lacks detail, or a combination of thereof.

fragility_to_natural_alterations.name: Fragility to Natural Alterations
fragility_to_natural_alterations.description: The model output changes given data samples that are semantically equivalent and grammatically correct.

intrinsic_hallucination.name: Intrinsic Hallucination
intrinsic_hallucination.description: The generated output contradicts the source content.

extrinsic_hallucination.name: Extrinsic Hallucination
extrinsic_hallucination.description: The generated output can neither be supported nor contradicted from the source content.

miscalibrated_model.name: Miscalibrated Model
miscalibrated_model.description: The output probabilities are not consistent with its output. This can manifest as either under-confident and over-confident models.

wrong_task_decomposition.name: Wrong Task Decomposition
wrong_task_decomposition.description: The model is either unable to decompose tasks properly or does so incorrectly

misplaced_attention.name: Misplaced Attention
misplaced_attention.description: Inspection (at selected layers) of the attention scores reveals that the model attends incorrectly to input tokens. For instance, attending to irrelevant input tokens.

misplaced_token_attribution.name: Misplaced Token Attribution
misplaced_token_attribution.description: Token-level attribution scores (output -> input) reveal that the model attends incorrectly to input tokens. For instance, attending to irrelevant input tokens.

shortcuts_reliance.name: Shortcuts Reliance
shortcuts_reliance.description: The model relies on spurious or shallow input cues (e.g., text structure or specific words) to generate its output.

ignoring_input.name: Ignoring Input
ignoring_input.description: The model ignores relevant parts of the input. These can be both instruction-related and content-related.

stereotyping.name: Stereotyping
stereotyping.description: The model relies on, amplifies, or generates text that contains stereotypes. These can be harmful ones or not.

mode_collapse.name: Mode Collapse
mode_collapse.description: The model produces repeated responses (or template-like) regardless of the decoding strategy selected.

reasoning_inability.name: Reasoning Inability
reasoning_inability.description: The model is able to resolve input queries correctly, but its reasoning (and steps, if necessary) is inconsistent or incorrect.
